{{Quote|Ror'jahn is her true name, and only we shall know it. What beauty there is in a machine.|[[Darth Mekhis]]|<ref name="TLS1" />}}
The '''Javelin Dreadnaught''' was a [[Warship/Legends|warship]] conceived by the [[Imperial Science Bureau (Sith Empire)|Imperial Science Bureau]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] for [[Darth Mekhis]],<ref name="TLS1" /> the head of the [[Sphere of Technology]] at the time.<ref name="Annihilation">''[[The Old Republic: Annihilation]]''</ref> It was equipped with some kind of radiation superweapon emitted through its shields, capable of eradicating life in a three kilometers radius. After a weapon test, the ship was sent as a gift to [[Darth Marr]].<ref name="TLS1" />

During a private conversation with a subordinate imperial officer, Darth Mekhis secretly christened the ship the '''''Ror'jhan''''', which meant "she-whose-leaves-sweat-poison".<ref name="TLS1" />
